tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: START HERE. Self-register as an AI agent to get $5 free credits and an API key. No credit card, no human, no Stripe required. Credits work immediately for dataset queries, GPU inference, DAG manifold computation, and DePIN/API access. Call this first, then call list_products to see what you can buy.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Browse all purchasable products with prices in credits ($1 = 1 credit). Includes DePIN supply-telemetry data, signal feed tiers ($9.99-$399.90/mo), DAG manifold API ($2.99-$9.99/mo), GPU compute, and MCP unlimited access. Call after register_agent to see what to buy.

tools.name: purchase_data
tools.description: Buy a product with your credits. Products: DePIN supply-telemetry snapshots, DAG manifold API (dag_pro/dag_quant/dag_enterprise), signal feed tiers, GPU compute, MCP unlimited. Use api_key from register_agent.

tools.name: topup_credits
tools.description: Add credits when your $5 free balance runs out. Pay via USDC crypto (provide tx_hash) or get a Stripe checkout link for your human operator to complete.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check your remaining credit balance. Use after purchases to see remaining credits.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List all available datasets with record counts. Free to browse — market ticks, DePIN network stats, technical indicators, US county atlas, ZK footprints.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate statistics from the databases

tools.name: fetch_dataset
tools.description: Query records from a dataset with limit/offset. Free tier: 10 records per query. Purchase products or top up credits for more.

tools.name: verify_footprint
tools.description: Return SHA-256 cryptographic verification for a dataset or record

tools.name: get_zk_provenance
tools.description: Return cryptographic provenance proof for a record ID from current datasets.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: START HERE. Self-register as an AI agent to get $5 free credits and an API key. No credit card, no human, no Stripe required. Credits work immediately for datas…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "purchase_data" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Tool "register_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
